title: Dairy Cattle Breeds: Red & White Holstein, Gyr/Gir, and Red Sindhi
text:
RED & WHITE HOLSTEIN
Origin: Netherlands
Markings: Red & white
Desirable Characteristics:
✓ Strong immune system
✓ Resistant to heat
✓ High quality udder and strong legs
Performance:
✓ 680-770kg

GYR/GIR
Origin: Gujarat, India
Markings: mottled color red, yellow and white
Desirable Characteristics:
✓ Heat resistant
✓ Tolerant to tropical diseases
✓ Udder conformation
Performance:
✓ 385kg
✓ 1590kg milk/year

RED SINDHI
Origin: Pakistan & India
Markings: Reddish brown to deep red
Desirable Characteristics:
✓ Heat tolerance
✓ Tick resistance
✓ Disease resistance
Performance:
✓ 350kg
✓ 3,500kg milk/year

facts: Red & White Holstein originates from the Netherlands.
Red & White Holstein markings are red and white.
Desirable characteristics of Red & White Holstein include a strong immune system, resistance to heat, high quality udder, and strong legs.
Performance weight of Red & White Holstein is 680-770 kg.
Gyr/Gir markings are mottled color red, yellow, and white.
Desirable characteristics of Gyr/Gir include being heat resistant, tolerant to tropical diseases, and having desirable udder conformation.
Performance weight of Gyr/Gir is 385 kg.
Annual milk production of Gyr/Gir is 1,590 kg milk/year.
Red Sindhi originates from Pakistan & India.
Red Sindhi markings range from reddish brown to deep red.
Desirable characteristics of Red Sindhi include heat tolerance, tick resistance, and disease resistance.
Performance weight of Red Sindhi is 350 kg.
Annual milk production of Red Sindhi is 3,500 kg milk/year.
